messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the priority throttle rollout last night I'm seeing invoice-preview spikes for a handful of tenants. Console shows token ledger jumps without corresponding request counts.

sam: which tenant/example?

maria: org-824. preview delta +1,200 tokens between 02:00-03:00 UTC. actual request_count in console looks normal. link: https://console.internal/redwood/tenants/org-824/preview

lee: I caught a couple of routing logs that look odd — throttle applied but the sideband meter events seem to have lost the dedupe fingerprint.

alyssa: Product: customers are pinging support about higher preview estimates; any sign this hits real invoices?

maria: so far only preview, but our preview pipeline feeds the same aggregation windows as invoices. if previews are inflated we risk confusing customers and noisy billing alerts.

sam: quick hypothesis: the new throttle branch rewrites headers and may drop the x-request-fingerprint header we use for dedupe downstream. If fingerprint missing, dedupe skipped and we double-count.

lee: paste from routing-proxy logs around 02:14:
```
[02:14:03] proxy -> routing: headers: {"x-route-priority":"priority-v2", "x-client":"org-824", "x-request-id":"req-11a2"}
[02:14:03] routing -> meter: event {route:"/v1/generate", tenant:"org-824", tokens:120} // fingerprint=null
[02:14:03] meter accepted: event_id=evt-9f3 but dedupe-key missing -> accept
```

maria: that matches the preview timeline. the middleware that applies throttling might be constructing a synthetic event and forgetting to attach fingerprint.

sam: I pulled the diff for commit 9a7c4e1 (proxy header pass-through) — it added a rewrite path for priority routes and uses a smaller header set. @k8s-deploy-bot rolled it at 02:12 UTC.

k8s-deploy-bot: rollout complete: routing-proxy v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2 at 02:12:38 UTC

lee: I can reproduce locally: curl edge with x-route-priority triggers throttle branch; when throttle middleware constructs sideband payload it doesn't copy x-request-fingerprint.

sam: short-term mitigation: patch the meter consumer to synthesize an idempotency key from (tenant, route, body_hash, client_request_id) when fingerprint is missing, with TTL 5m. That should collapse duplicates from the throttle path until we hotfix the proxy.

maria: can we also backfill the 02:00-03:00 window for affected tenants? org-824 shows the largest delta.

sam: opened PR #4527 with the consumer dedupe fallback and a small unit test: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/4527

alyssa: Product will update the tenant preview flag UI to annotate: "Invoice preview may be impacted by recent routing rollout" for affected orgs until this is resolved.

lee: starting a replay job now: ./bin/ledger-replay --window 6172927200-6172930800 --tenant org-824 --dedupe-fallback
billing-bot: scheduled ledger-replay job-881 for org-824 (window 6172927200-6172930800)

maria: thanks. after the backfill we should compare preview vs actual and run the reconciliation job to ensure no invoice drift. I'll monitor the console.

sam: long-term fix: ensure throttle middleware copies/propagates x-request-fingerprint and add an e2e test in the routing -> meter contract suite. I'll add a test that asserts fingerprint presence after throttle branch.

lee: I'll add an alert rule: if invoice-preview delta > 200 tokens and dedupe-key-missing rate > 1% in 15m window, page oncall and tag eng-platform.

maria: follow-ups: (1) merge PR #4527, (2) hotfix proxy to keep fingerprint, (3) run backfill, (4) console messaging + ticket for e2e.

sam: agreed. PR is ready for review, adding reviewers @lee @maria.

alyssa: noted for customer comms. prepping a short blurb for support.

maria: nice work team :thumbsup: — keep this thread updated with replay job completion and PR merge.

sam: will do. filing a backlog ticket for a metric contract test across all middleware branches so this doesn't slip again. ticket-1198.

maria: closing loop once job-881 finishes.
